title.hi: वो माँ, जिसने कृष्ण को शाप दिया
वो माँ, जिसने कृष्ण को शाप दिया

scenes.notes: Series sting, reused in every S01 episode. Border closes in, stamp lands.

narration.en: A mother cursed Krishna. He smiled… and made it come true.
narration.hi: एक माँ ने कृष्ण को शाप दिया। वो मुस्कुराए… और उसे सच कर दिया।

scenes.notes: A blindfolded queen, palm raised at Krishna. CE 11.25.39. Thumbnail.
The faint smile. CE 11.25.43.
It comes true: the end, shown first. CE 16.4.36-42.

narration.en: The war was over. All hundred sons of Queen Gandhari were dead.
narration.hi: युद्ध ख़त्म हो चुका था। रानी गांधारी के सौ के सौ बेटे मारे गए थे।

scenes.notes: Broken wheels, banners, no bodies.
She bound her own eyes for her blind husband (1.103.13). Hands empty.

narration.en: She held back from cursing the Pandavas, who killed them: "My own son caused this."
narration.hi: मारने वाले पांडवों को उन्होंने शाप नहीं दिया। बोलीं: "दोष मेरे ही बेटे का था।"

scenes.notes: The raised hand is held back by her own other hand. CE 11.13.2-15, 11.15.2-8.
"Duryodhana..." CE 11.13.14.

narration.en: But seeing the battlefield, she asked Krishna: "You could have stopped this. Why did you look on?"
narration.hi: पर रणभूमि देखकर वो कृष्ण से बोलीं: "तुम ये रोक सकते थे। फिर क्यों देखते रहे?"

scenes.notes: The widows among the lamps. CE 11.16.9-19.
Open palm, not a pointing finger. CE 11.25.36-37.
THE question of the episode: upeksitah, "looked on".

narration.en: He had tried. He'd asked for peace, and her son refused.
narration.hi: कृष्ण ने रोकना चाहा था। वो शांति माँगने गए थे, पर गांधारी का बेटा नहीं माना।

scenes.notes: Before the war: the envoy. CE 5.91, 5.93.
Proud, turned away.

narration.en: Grieving, she cursed him: "You let my clan die. You'll destroy yours! In the thirty-sixth year, you'll lose them all, and meet your end wandering the forest!"
narration.hi: शोक में गांधारी ने शाप दिया: "तुमने मेरा कुल मिटने दिया। तुम अपना ही कुल मिटाओगे! छत्तीसवें बरस सबको खोकर, वन में भटकते अंत पाओगे!"

scenes.notes: Close: you will destroy yours.
What she sees: his clan. CE 11.25.41.
One figure among trees. CE 11.25.41 (vanecarah).

narration.en: Krishna smiled faintly: "I know. Only I can end my clan."
narration.hi: कृष्ण मुस्कुराए: "जानता हूँ। मेरे कुल का अंत मैं ही कर सकता हूँ।"

scenes.notes: "As if slightly smiling." CE 11.25.43-44.
The Pandavas, stricken, behind him. CE 11.25.46.

narration.en: Thirty-six years later, the omens of war returned. Krishna remembered her words.
narration.hi: छत्तीस बरस बाद, युद्ध वाले अपशकुन लौट आए। कृष्ण को गांधारी के शब्द याद आए।

scenes.notes: Thirty-six years of peace. CE 16.1.1.
The moon gives the war's sign again. CE 16.3.16-18.
He remembers her. CE 16.3.19.

narration.en: He could have stopped it. Instead, he led his clan to the seashore, to make her words true.
narration.hi: वो रोक सकते थे। पर उन शब्दों को सच करने, अपने कुल को समुद्र किनारे ले गए।

scenes.notes: Able, and choosing. CE 16.9.26-27.
The pilgrimage he ordered "to make it true". CE 16.3.21-22.

narration.en: There, an old war quarrel set them on each other. And Krishna looked on: their hour had come.
narration.hi: वहाँ युद्ध के एक पुराने झगड़े पर सब आपस में लड़ मरे। कृष्ण देखते रहे। समय आ चुका था।

scenes.notes: Satyaki and Kritavarma: the night raid thrown in the face. CE 16.4.16-27.
Grass turns to iron (shown, not told). CE 16.4.34-39.
He stands, knowing the turn of time. CE 16.4.42. Still, sorrowful, upright.

narration.en: Alone in the forest, he lay down in yoga. A hunter took him for a deer, and shot.
narration.hi: अकेले वन में, वो योग में लेट गए। एक शिकारी ने हिरण समझकर बाण चला दिया।

scenes.notes: The forest of E02, where Pandu took a sage for a deer. CE 16.5.16.
On the bare ground, in yoga. CE 16.5.16-19.
Close: a hunter at dusk.
What he thinks he sees, through leaves. Only the arrow flies. CE 16.5.20.

narration.en: The hunter fell at his feet. Krishna didn't curse him. He comforted him… and rose, filling earth and sky with light.
narration.hi: शिकारी उनके पैरों में गिर पड़ा। कृष्ण ने उसे शाप नहीं, दिलासा दिया… और धरती-आकाश को प्रकाश से भरते हुए ऊपर उठ गए।

scenes.notes: He sees whom he has struck. CE 16.5.20-21.
Close: comfort. The same faint smile. CE 16.5.21.
Filling earth and sky with light. CE 16.5.21-25.

narration.en: Eight stories of curses. The last word is mercy.
narration.hi: शाप की आठ कहानियाँ। और आख़िरी शब्द: करुणा।

scenes.notes: Eight emblems: stake, deer, bangles, river, wheel, snake, worm, blindfold.
A peacock feather settles in the middle of the curses.

narration.en: Next season on Shraap: Ashwatthama, the warrior Krishna did curse.
narration.hi: शाप के अगले सीज़न में: अश्वत्थामा, वो योद्धा जिसे कृष्ण ने ख़ुद शाप दिया।

scenes.notes: The stamp word is spoken.
A lone warrior, walking away under a dark sky. Krishna's curse: CE 10.16.9-12.
